newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU restricts live pig exports from Spain.
newsitem.headline: EU restricts live pig exports from Spain.

text.p: The European Union imposed Thursday an immediate curb on all live pig exports from Spain because of swine fever, a European Commission spokesman said.
"All live pig exports from Spain are banned with the exception of animals from herds which have been closed for thirty days and are free of the disease," agriculture spokesman Gerard Kiely said.
The EU Standing Veterinary Committee imposed a total ban on the movement of pigs from the Pladargelle region and four surrounding districts of Urgell, Noguera, Segira and Garrigues.
"Only pigs being taken directly to slaughter will be allowed to be transported from those areas," Kiely said.
The ban follows an outbreak of swine fever reported by the Spanish authorities last week.
The EU committee will review the situation May 15.
